meta.title: Workspace categories and blocks
meta.description: Groups sidebar Workspaces into themed, rounded category blocks that always stay on top and can be collapsed, and gives every Workspace its own highlight block so an expanded Session list never blurs into the next one. Usage: click the new button right of "add workspace" in the Workspaces header to create a category; its name opens in place, so just type. Drag a Workspace anywhere onto the block — its header, any member card, or the dashed area of an empty category — to file it, and a category holds any number of Workspaces; drag a categorized Workspace down into the Uncategorized area to take it back out. Click the block's blank title area or the chevron on its left to collapse or expand it. Drag the six-dot grip on the left of a title, or the block itself, to change the category order — categories always sit above uncategorized Workspaces — and Alt+Arrow moves the focused category too. The dot before the category name opens a color panel with the seven macOS Finder tag colors; the three-dot button opens a Rename / Delete category menu built from the same material, placement and icons as the shipped Workspace row menu, and deleting asks once and returns its Workspaces to Uncategorized. Categories live only in this browser's localStorage (dsh.workspace.categories.v1): nothing is uploaded, Workspace and Session data are untouched, and clearing site data loses them. Category blocks appear in the grouped-by-Workspace view only; the Workspace tree keeps the top-level per-Workspace blocks but shows no categories, the flat list has no Workspace groups so the plugin leaves it alone, and the category UI hides itself while the sidebar is a rail or a Session search is open. All copy follows the app language, and the blocks have separate dark and light tuning.
